description:
Just when he thought his life had completely fallen apart… What awaited him instead was— a team of unpredictable, dangerously charming older moms?! “Coach~ you do know things bounce when I run… right? ♥” The soccer field is turning into a chaotic stage where hidden desires and mischievous romance start to tangle together… A reckless new coach × beginner players who are married or single moms— and a training ground where the tension never dies down. A whirlwind of lust, chaos, and complicated relationships. With these voluptuous single mothers by his side, he sets out to challenge the national tournament! A wild, unpredictable body-driven relationship between a rookie coach and his rookie players— No one knows where this will lead next…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
